final: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS rate_ratio FROM r
